About this tool

Type or paste any text, link, phone number or message — a QR code is generated instantly and you can download it as an image, free and with no sign-up.

Frequently asked questions

Does the QR code expire?

No — the QR code is generated directly in your browser and encodes your text permanently. It doesn't rely on a shortened link that can expire.

Can I use this for a UPI payment QR or Wi-Fi QR?

You can generate a QR from any correctly formatted text, including UPI payment strings or Wi-Fi connection strings, though you'll need to format that text correctly yourself.
